name: agency-sale-manager
description: Agency Sale Manager — Vudu Tech. Retrospective 12-month commission snapshot for an insurance agency sale.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @asm/admin run build && npm --workspace @asm/functions run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @asm/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @asm/functions run typecheck && npm --workspace @asm/admin run typecheck
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-asm-rules "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/assert-dev-target.mjs dev && firebase deploy --project dev --only firestore,storage,functions
scripts.seed:dev: node scripts/assert-dev-target.mjs dev && node scripts/seed-dev.mjs dev
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/assert-prod-deploy.mjs && firebase deploy --project prod --only firestore,storage,functions
